_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Missing transcription is explained instead of recording. The server has no transcription available. window.__recordingMock.microphoneRequests counts the microphone captures the page requested. The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button.
2. ".status-error" should contain "Set OPENAI_API_KEY", and no recording panel may exist (count 0).
3. Press the record-audio shortcut. No recording panel may exist (count 0).
4. window.__recordingMock.microphoneRequests must be 0.
